svg.title: Figure 8.2 Rejection regions for the three forms of the alternative hypothesis
svg.desc: Three normal curves for the sample mean, each centered at μ₀ on the x̄ axis. For Hₐ: μ < μ₀, the left tail of area α below the critical value C is shaded, and the rejection region below it is the interval to the left of C. For Hₐ: μ > μ₀, the right tail of area α above the critical value C′ is shaded, and the rejection region is the interval to the right of C′. For Hₐ: μ ≠ μ₀, both tails, each of area α/2, are shaded beyond C and C′, and the rejection region is both outer intervals.
